workLog: invoke_precommit_security.py: added timeouts to the gh --version, code-scanning gh api, Get-Module and Install-Module calls; a TimeoutExpired now degrades PSScriptAnalyzer to unavailable; the code-scanning timeout is caught by the existing SubprocessError handler and skips.
invoke_precommit_security.py: the discarded _stage_security_report return is now checked; a staging failure fails the run with exit 1 instead of passing without the required report.

run_semgrep.py: added a 300s timeout to the scan subprocess and a dedicated TimeoutExpired branch that returns a blocking ERROR semgrep-scan-failure finding so a hung scan cannot silently pass the gate.
mcp_client.py: added a win32 reader-thread read timeout so os.read cannot block forever on Windows, and an overall monotonic deadline in _read_response against notification/id-mismatch floods.
